Athletic Progressive Club Hellas Syros | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1929}} | owner = | chairman = Giorgos Leontaritis | manager = [[Thanasis Staikos]] |league = [[Super League Greece 2]] | season = [[2025–26 Super League Greece 2#South Group|2025–26]] | position = Super League Greece 2 (South Group), 5th | website = {{URL|https://www.hellassyrou.gr/}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = | body1 = | rightarm1 = | shorts1 = 0000ff | socks1 = 0000ff | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = | body2 = | rightarm2 = | shorts2 = | socks2 = }} The '''Athletic Progressive Club Hellas Syros'''{{Cite web|url=https://somateia2023.gga.gov.gr/eggegramena-somateia?eggegrammeno_2023=1&kodikos_gga=%CE%9B%CE%A670&name=%CE%91%CE%98%CE%9B%CE%97%CE%A4%CE%99%CE%9A%CE%9F%CE%A3+%CE%A0%CE%A1%CE%9F%CE%9F%CE%94%CE%95%CE%A5%CE%A4%CE%99%CE%9A%CE%9F%CE%A3+%CE%9F%CE%9C%CE%99%CE%9B%CE%9F%CE%A3+%CE%95%CE%9B%CE%9B%CE%91%CE%A3+%CE%A3%CE%A5%CE%A1%CE%9F%CE%A5&omospondia=82542&athlima=%CE%A0%CE%9F%CE%94%CE%9F%CE%A3%CE%A6%CE%91%CE%99%CE%A1%CE%9F&perifereia=%CE%9D%CE%9F%CE%A4%CE%99%CE%9F%CE%A5+%CE%91%CE%99%CE%93%CE%91%CE%99%CE%9F%CE%A5&perifereiaki_enotita=%CE%A3%CE%A5%CE%A1%CE%9F%CE%A5&dimos=%CE%A3%CE%A5%CE%A1%CE%9F%CE%A5+%E2%80%93+%CE%95%CE%A1%CE%9C%CE%9F%CE%A5%CE%A0%CE%9F%CE%9B%CE%97%CE%A3&op=%CE%A6%CE%AF%CE%BB%CF%84%CF%81%CE%BF|title=Εγγεγραμμένα σωματεία {{!}} Ηλεκτρονικό Μητρώο Αθλητικών Σωματείων με Ειδική Αθλητική Αναγνώριση|website=somateia2023.gga.gov.gr|accessdate=2024-04-28}} is a Greek [[association football|football]] [[Football club (association football)|club]] based in [[Ermoupolis]], [[Syros]]. It was founded in 1929 but was officially recognized as a club by the [[Hellenic Football Federation|HFF]] in 1946 under the name "'''Progressive Association of Fans Hellas'''". Its official colors are blue and white, and its [[emblem]] is the [[Flag of Greece]]. It uses the Municipal Stadium of Ermoupolis as its home ground, which features artificial [[turf]] and a built grandstand with a capacity of 2,500 seats. It currently operates a men's football department, while in the past it had sections for women's football, [[Sport of athletics|track and field]], [[volleyball]], and [[basketball]]. In the past, the men's football team has competed for three seasons in the [[Fourth Division (Greece)|Fourth National Division]] and two in the [[Gamma Ethniki]]. It currently competes in the [[Greek football league system|second tier]] [[Super League Greece 2]] under the name "'''Athletic Progressive Club Hellas Syros Football Public Limited Company'''" and the trade title "'''Hellas Syros P.A.E.'''".{{Cite web|url=https://publicity.businessportal.gr/company/185725338000|title=ΓΕΜΗ :: Υπηρεσίες Δημοσιότητας|website=publicity.businessportal.gr|accessdate=2025-07-08}}"}}
